question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Dampness.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in **blank number 4** is** "dampness".**
 
• The sentence suggests that the raindrops had fallen on the wall under the windows not far from his cell and made the side of his bed cool.
 
• So, it implies that the rainwater might have seeped into the wall and made it damp, which would have resulted in the side of the bed becoming cool.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• I felt the **dampness **of the soil as I walked across the garden after the rain.
 
• The **dampness **of the room made it difficult for my clothes to dry quickly.
 
 
 
• The other options and their meanings are:
 
 
• **Openness: **The state of being open or unrestricted.
 
• **Stiffness: **The state of being stiff or rigid.
 
• **Softness: **The state of being soft or yielding.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *A (1) __loud__* *thunderstorm rolled across the Delta before dawn, and Sam was (2) __awakened__* *by the crack of lightning. He heard raindrops dropping hard against the open windows above the hallway. Then he heard them drip and (3) __puddle__* *against the wall under the windows not far from his cell. The **(4) __dampness__** - of his bed was suddenly cool. Maybe today (5) _________ not be so hot.*
